fullText.simplified:
十二、一张画

    常平来到了小房间的门口，他向里面看了一眼，没有人，很多东西都倒在地上。
    刚才这儿怎么了？白雪说有人在打她的朋友，那人呢？常平又看了看这个房间，突然，不知道为什么，他觉得自己好像认识这里。这张桌子，这张床，地上的这些画……这些他好像在哪儿见过，怎么回事？他为什么会认识这里？常平的头很疼，不对不对，一定是他记错了。他没来过这里，他不应该认识这里。
    常平拿起地上的画，画上有一个很高的人。他的脸很奇怪，有三只眼睛，两张嘴。他在笑，他的笑让人害怕。他的手里拿着什么东西？常平看不清楚。再看看，常平发现画上还有五个小朋友，他们在哭。他们的脸上，身上都有血。画的最右边，有一个瘦瘦小小的孩子，没有穿鞋，在向门外跑。
    这张画……常平觉得自己见过。为什么会见过？在哪里见过？常平的头更疼了。突然，常平好像想起来一些事情。他和五个小朋友一起在地下室里，他们没办法出去……怎么会想起这样的事情？头疼，特别特别的疼。他又想起来了一些，他拿到了门卡，跑出了地下室。后来他想回去帮那几个小朋友，他想找一个大人一起回去帮那几个小朋友……“怎么回事？这都是怎么回事？我在想什么？”
    常平看向地面，血，桌子下面有血……等一下，那是什么？篮球？桌子下面有一个篮球？这个篮球好像是……常平把篮球拿了出来，再看了看，上面写着“James”。这是他送给牛医生的那个篮球！
fullText.traditional:
十二、一張畫

    常平來到了小房間的門口，他向裡面看了一眼，沒有人，很多東西都倒在地上。
    剛才這兒怎麼了？白雪說有人在打她的朋友，那人呢？常平又看了看這個房間，突然，不知道為什麼，他覺得自己好像認識這裡。這張桌子，這張床，地上的這些畫……這些他好像在哪兒見過，怎麼回事？他為什麼會認識這裡？常平的頭很疼，不對不對，一定是他記錯了。他沒來過這裡，他不應該認識這裡。
    常平拿起地上的畫，畫上有一個很高的人。他的臉很奇怪，有三隻眼睛，兩張嘴。他在笑，他的笑讓人害怕。他的手裡拿著什麼東西？常平看不清楚。再看看，常平發現畫上還有五個小朋友，他們在哭。他們的臉上，身上都有血。畫的最右邊，有一個瘦瘦小小的孩子，沒有穿鞋，在向門外跑。
    這張畫……常平覺得自己見過。為什麼會見過？在哪裡見過？常平的頭更疼了。突然，常平好像想起來一些事情。他和五個小朋友一起在地下室裡，他們沒辦法出去……怎麼會想起這樣的事情？頭疼，特別特別的疼。他又想起來了一些，他拿到了門卡，跑出了地下室。後來他想回去幫那幾個小朋友，他想找一個大人一起回去幫那幾個小朋友……“怎麼回事？這都是怎麼回事？我在想什麼？”
    常平看向地面，血，桌子下面有血……等一下，那是什麼？籃球？桌子下面有一個籃球？這個籃球好像是……常平把籃球拿了出來，再看了看，上面寫著“James”。這是他送給牛醫生的那個籃球！

sentences.traditional: 常平來到了小房間的門口，他向裡面看了一眼，沒有人，很多東西都倒在地上。
sentences.pinyin: cháng píng lái dào le xiǎo fáng jiān de mén kǒu tā xiàng lǐ miàn kàn le yì yǎn méi yǒu rén hěn duō dōng xi dōu dǎo zài dì shang
sentences.english: Changping arrived at the entrance of the small room. He glanced inside. No one was there, and many things were scattered on the floor.

sentences.simplified: 刚才这儿怎么了？白雪说有人在打她的朋友，那人呢？
sentences.traditional: 剛才這兒怎麼了？白雪說有人在打她的朋友，那人呢？
sentences.pinyin: gāng cái zhè‘r zěn me le bái xuě shuō yǒu rén zài dǎ tā de péng you nà rén ne
sentences.english: What just happened here? Baixue said someone was hitting her friends. Where was that person?

sentences.simplified: 常平又看了看这个房间，突然，不知道为什么，他觉得自己好像认识这里。
sentences.traditional: 常平又看了看這個房間，突然，不知道為什麼，他覺得自己好像認識這裡。
sentences.pinyin: cháng píng yòu kàn le kàn zhè ge fáng jiān tū rán bù zhī dào wèi shén me tā jué de zì jǐ hǎo xiàng rèn shi zhè lǐ
sentences.english: Changping looked around the room again, and suddenly, for some reason, he felt as if he recognized this place.

sentences.simplified: 这张桌子，这张床，地上的这些画……这些他好像在哪儿见过，怎么回事？
sentences.traditional: 這張桌子，這張床，地上的這些畫……這些他好像在哪兒見過，怎麼回事？
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhuō zi zhè zhāng chuáng dì shang de zhè xiē huà zhè xiē tā hǎo xiàng zài nǎ'r jiàn guò zěn me huí shì
sentences.english: This table, this bed, these drawings on the floor … He seemed to have seen them somewhere before. What was going on?

sentences.simplified: 他为什么会认识这里？常平的头很疼，不对不对，一定是他记错了。
sentences.traditional: 他為什麼會認識這裡？常平的頭很疼，不對不對，一定是他記錯了。
sentences.pinyin: tā wèi shén me huì rèn shi zhè lǐ cháng píng de tóu hěn téng bú duì bú duì yí dìng shì tā jì cuò le
sentences.english: Why did he recognize this place? Changping’s head hurt a lot. No, no, he must have remembered it wrong.

sentences.simplified: 他没来过这里，他不应该认识这里。
sentences.traditional: 他沒來過這裡，他不應該認識這裡。
sentences.pinyin: tā méi lái guò zhè lǐ tā bù yīng gāi rèn shi zhè lǐ
sentences.english: He had never been here. He shouldn’t recognize this place.

sentences.simplified: 常平拿起地上的画，画上有一个很高的人。
sentences.traditional: 常平拿起地上的畫，畫上有一個很高的人。
sentences.pinyin: cháng píng ná qǐ dì shang de huà huà shang yǒu yí ge hěn gāo de rén
sentences.english: Changping picked up a drawing on the ground. There was a very tall person in the drawing.

sentences.simplified: 他的脸很奇怪，有三只眼睛，两张嘴。他在笑，他的笑让人害怕。
sentences.traditional: 他的臉很奇怪，有三隻眼睛，兩張嘴。他在笑，他的笑讓人害怕。
sentences.pinyin: tā de liǎn hěn qí guài yǒu sān zhī yǎn jing liǎng zhāng zuǐ tā zài xiào tā de xiào ràng rén hài pà
sentences.english: His face was very strange, with three eyes and two mouths. He was laughing, and his laugh was frightening.

sentences.simplified: 他的手里拿着什么东西？常平看不清楚。
sentences.traditional: 他的手裡拿著什麼東西？常平看不清楚。
sentences.pinyin: tā de shǒu lǐ ná zhe shén me dōng xi cháng píng kàn bù qīng chu
sentences.english: What object was he holding in his hand? Changping couldn’t see clearly.

sentences.simplified: 再看看，常平发现画上还有五个小朋友，他们在哭。
sentences.traditional: 再看看，常平發現畫上還有五個小朋友，他們在哭。
sentences.pinyin: zài kàn kan cháng píng fā xiàn huà shang hái yǒu wǔ ge xiǎo péng you tā men zài kū
sentences.english: Looking at it again, Changping found that there were five children in the drawing, and they were crying.

sentences.simplified: 他们的脸上，身上都有血。
sentences.traditional: 他們的臉上，身上都有血。
sentences.pinyin: tā men de liǎn shang shēn shang dōu yǒu xiě
sentences.english: There was blood on their faces and bodies.

sentences.simplified: 画的最右边，有一个瘦瘦小小的孩子，没有穿鞋，在向门外跑。
sentences.traditional: 畫的最右邊，有一個瘦瘦小小的孩子，沒有穿鞋，在向門外跑。
sentences.pinyin: huà de zuì yòu bian yǒu yí ge shòu shòu xiǎo xiǎo de hái zi méi yǒu chuān xié zài xiàng mén wài pǎo
sentences.english: On the far right of the drawing, there was a skinny little child, who wasn’t wearing shoes, running towards the door.

sentences.simplified: 这张画……常平觉得自己见过。
sentences.traditional: 這張畫……常平覺得自己見過。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhāng huà cháng píng jué de zì jǐ jiàn guò
sentences.english: This drawing … Changping felt like he had seen it before.

sentences.simplified: 为什么会见过？在哪里见过？常平的头更疼了。
sentences.traditional: 為什麼會見過？在哪裡見過？常平的頭更疼了。
sentences.pinyin: wèi shén me huì jiàn guò zài nǎ lǐ jiàn guò cháng píng de tóu gèng téng le
sentences.english: Why had seen it before? Where had he seen it before? Changping’s head hurt even more.

sentences.simplified: 突然，常平好像想起来一些事情。
sentences.traditional: 突然，常平好像想起來一些事情。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán cháng píng hǎo xiàng xiǎng qǐ lái yì xiē shì qing
sentences.english: Suddenly, Changping seemed to remember some things.

sentences.simplified: 他和五个小朋友一起在地下室里，他们没办法出去……怎么会想起这样的事情？
sentences.traditional: 他和五個小朋友一起在地下室裡，他們沒辦法出去……怎麼會想起這樣的事情？
sentences.pinyin: tā hé wǔ ge xiǎo péng you yì qǐ zài dì xià shì lǐ tā men méi bàn fǎ chū qù zěn me huì xiǎng qǐ zhè yàng de shì qing
sentences.english: He and the five children were together in the basement. They were unable to get out … How could he remember such a thing?

sentences.simplified: 头疼，特别特别的疼。
sentences.traditional: 頭疼，特別特別的疼。
sentences.pinyin: tóu téng tè bié tè bié de téng
sentences.english: His head hurt. It really, really hurt.

sentences.simplified: 他又想起来了一些，他拿到了门卡，跑出了地下室。
sentences.traditional: 他又想起來了一些，他拿到了門卡，跑出了地下室。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu xiǎng qǐ lái le yì xiē tā ná dào le mén kǎ pǎo chū le dì xià shì
sentences.english: He again remembered something more. He got the keycard and ran out of the basement.

sentences.simplified: 后来他想回去帮那几个小朋友，他想找一个大人一起回去帮那几个小朋友……
sentences.traditional: 後來他想回去幫那幾個小朋友，他想找一個大人一起回去幫那幾個小朋友……
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái tā xiǎng huí qù bāng nà jǐ ge xiǎo péng you tā xiǎng zhǎo yí ge dà ren yì qǐ huí qù bāng nà jǐ ge xiǎo péng you
sentences.english: Afterwards, he wanted to go back and help those children. He wanted to find an adult to go back with him to help those children …

sentences.simplified: “怎么回事？这都是怎么回事？我在想什么？”
sentences.traditional: “怎麼回事？這都是怎麼回事？我在想什麼？”
sentences.pinyin: zěn me huí shì zhè dōu shì zěn me huí shì wǒ zài xiǎng shén me
sentences.english: “What’s going on? What does this all mean? What am I thinking?”

sentences.simplified: 常平看向地面，血，桌子下面有血……
sentences.traditional: 常平看向地面，血，桌子下面有血……
sentences.pinyin: cháng píng kàn xiàng dì miàn xiě zhuō zi xià miàn yǒu xiě
sentences.english: Changping looked at the ground. Blood. There was blood under the table …

sentences.simplified: 等一下，那是什么？篮球？桌子下面有一个篮球？
sentences.traditional: 等一下，那是什麼？籃球？桌子下面有一個籃球？
sentences.pinyin: děng yí xià nà shì shén me lán qiú zhuō zi xià miàn yǒu yí ge lán qiú
sentences.english: Wait, what is that? A basketball? There is a basketball under the table?

sentences.simplified: 这个篮球好像是……常平把篮球拿了出来，再看了看，上面写着“James”。
sentences.traditional: 這個籃球好像是……常平把籃球拿了出來，再看了看，上面寫著“James”。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge lán qiú hǎo xiàng shì cháng píng bǎ lán qiú ná le chu lai zài kàn le kàn shàng miàn xiě zhe 1
sentences.english: This basketball seemed to be … Changping took out the basketball and looked at it again. It had “James” written on it.

sentences.simplified: 这是他送给牛医生的那个篮球！
sentences.traditional: 這是他送給牛醫生的那個籃球！
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì tā sòng gěi niú yī shēng de nà ge lán qiú
sentences.english: This was the basketball he gave to Dr. Niu!

sentence_translations: 12. A Drawing
Changping arrived at the entrance of the small room. He glanced inside. No one was there, and many things were scattered on the floor.
What just happened here? Baixue said someone was hitting her friends. Where was that person?
Changping looked around the room again, and suddenly, for some reason, he felt as if he recognized this place.
This table, this bed, these drawings on the floor … He seemed to have seen them somewhere before. What was going on?
Why did he recognize this place? Changping’s head hurt a lot. No, no, he must have remembered it wrong.
He had never been here. He shouldn’t recognize this place.
Changping picked up a drawing on the ground. There was a very tall person in the drawing.
His face was very strange, with three eyes and two mouths. He was laughing, and his laugh was frightening.
What object was he holding in his hand? Changping couldn’t see clearly.
Looking at it again, Changping found that there were five children in the drawing, and they were crying.
There was blood on their faces and bodies.
On the far right of the drawing, there was a skinny little child, who wasn’t wearing shoes, running towards the door.
This drawing … Changping felt like he had seen it before.
Why had seen it before? Where had he seen it before? Changping’s head hurt even more.
Suddenly, Changping seemed to remember some things.
He and the five children were together in the basement. They were unable to get out … How could he remember such a thing?
His head hurt. It really, really hurt.
He again remembered something more. He got the keycard and ran out of the basement.
Afterwards, he wanted to go back and help those children. He wanted to find an adult to go back with him to help those children …
“What’s going on? What does this all mean? What am I thinking?”
Changping looked at the ground. Blood. There was blood under the table …
Wait, what is that? A basketball? There is a basketball under the table?
This basketball seemed to be … Changping took out the basketball and looked at it again. It had “James” written on it.
This was the basketball he gave to Dr. Niu!
